# Agent Display NEBULA source notice

This project contains a source-derived port of the NEBULA theme from
[`cyberdaddyleo/agent-display`](https://github.com/cyberdaddyleo/agent-display).

- Upstream source: `index.html`, blob `0cf90348d7ad7f179e6f851562ed92be2530b92c`
- Extracted source regions: the `tpl-nebula` template and complete `mountNebula(host, SR)` implementation
- Local modifications: ES module imports for three.js 0.186.1, Shadow DOM mounting, React lifecycle adapter, explicit WebGL disposal, snapshot/event/controller API, and diagnostic reporting
- Upstream license: PolyForm Noncommercial License 1.0.0; a verbatim copy is stored beside this notice
- Use in this project: noncommercial teaching, research, and competition demonstration

The original in-scene credit remains visible in the ported HUD.
